findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "smartfin_get_embed_code" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: The HTML to put one of SmartFin's free calculators on a website the user runs: a blog post, a class or library page, a client resources page. One iframe line, f…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smartfin_get_embed_code · Public sink: smartfin_project_savings_growth, smartfin_get_embed_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smartfin_get_embed_code · Public sink: smartfin_project_savings_growth, smartfin_get_embed_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
